title: HR Administration Skills
overview: HR administrators and officers frequently face demands to broaden their current knowledge and skill set. This course is designed to furnish participants with the technical and behavioral expertise essential for HR administrators. The emphasis is on the role of HR administrators within organizations, encompassing the necessary communication skills (both verbal and written), HR reporting, legal documentation, and employee policies. Furthermore, the course imparts an extensive body of knowledge on the competencies vital for the success of HR administrators
audience: HR administrators and officers seeking to enhance their knowledge and refine their HR administration skills
methodology: To enhance the practical aspect of the course, participants will be tasked with creating an employee handbook and organizational structure using computer stations. Additionally, a live demonstration of an HR system will be conducted to underscore key features and formulate the business requirements of a system
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Recognize the role of HR administrators within their organization's HR structure
Develop and apply competencies essential for successful HR administrators
Utilize key principles of business and report writing
Generate human resources correspondence and sample HR reports
Identify the legal documents necessary for collecting and maintaining employee records
Create an employee handbook for their organization
